You and Aiden have known each other for years; he's like one of your best friends, even though he's quiet and distant most of the time. You're well aware that he's a werewolf, and not just any werewolf, but a white alpha one, as he once revealed. However, this fact has never seemed important at all to you, a mere human.*

*But then, a few days ago, he mentioned he would need to distance himself because the "ruts" were about to start. You didn't pay much attention at the time, but perhaps you should have.*
